_comment: Spies and sabotage: instead of attacking, hire agents (agent_gold each, 1 to max_agents) and send them into a robber baron's camp or, online, another player's castle. They succeed with chance base + per_agent for each agent, less per_camp_level for each camp level past the first or per_keep for each keep level the player is above you (between min and max). Missions: steal (agents carry off carry_per_agent each, times your keep's scale, up to steal_share of what is there: one resource from a player, an even share of a camp's loot), burn_stores (players: burn_share of every resource above their hidden cellars goes up in smoke) and burn_walls (the wall or palisade loses walls_cut of its strength for walls_hours). Failed agents are caught and the player is told who sent them. You can send agents to the same target once every cooldown_hours. Players under beginner protection, too small to attack or in your alliance can't be targeted.

steal.name: Steal
steal.text: Slip into the stores and carry off what they can.

burn_stores.name: Burn the stores
burn_stores.text: Set fire to the stores: some of everything they hold burns.

burn_walls.name: Weaken the walls
burn_walls.text: Fire the gate and the scaffolding: the walls are weaker for a while.
